label: Only a short window for a major revival
description: That the cleaning of the house of America leaves only a short little window for a major revival, given in prayer alongside calling in unsaved loved ones.

label: The Mexican president's day is coming like Maduro's
description: A prayer that the day of the Mexican president is coming just as the Venezuelan leader's did, that a good government is put over Mexico soon, and that great revival comes to Mexico from the top down.

label: Taiwan will not have a communist government
description: Declared in prayer that China will not take Taiwan and will not be allowed to in the spirit realm, that the Chinese leader must bow the knee, go back and release his people, and that Taiwan will not have a communist government.

label: Greenland used as a pawn to negotiate over Ukraine
description: Greenland described as a pawn piece being used to negotiate with Ukraine, with the Greenlanders themselves having no say in it.

label: The minerals are to back the dollar, and Cuba is next
description: That the point of the acquisition is not the missile defence dome but backing the dollar and making it stronger, that it is the minerals rather than Venezuelan oil, that it is being played like Monopoly, and that soon it will be Cuba.

label: A game of chess to stay the world's reserve currency
description: His reading of the Venezuela operation as strategy rather than word: a game of chess about staying on top and staying the world's reserve currency, with the instruction to keep American hands out of one part of it.

label: A great shaking is coming to the Catholic Church
description: A great shaking coming to the Catholic Church, given while he is repeatedly seeing Cuba and asking why.

label: The racket of war, and prayer as the assignment
description: The phrase the racket of war given over the Israel and Iran conflict and the innocent lives in it, followed by the question what are you going to do about it and the answer that prayer is the assignment.

label: Europe devises its own plan and keeps the American president out
description: European powers coming to the table not to make peace but to defuse it on their own terms, not wanting the American president involved and devising their own plan while he tries to have influence.

label: A surprise attack from Iran that will be blamed on the Houthis
description: A surprise attack coming from Iran during the Abraham Accords peace process, which he says they will attribute to the Houthis rather than to Iran. The attribution is the checkable part.

label: Do not parrot other prophets; get it from the source
description: His criticism of prophetic voices who repeat what they heard another prophet say rather than receiving it from the Father, given immediately before an instruction he says he received directly to warn about a terrorist attack that day.

label: Volcanoes in the middle of the ocean become active as a sign
description: Volcanic activity coming out in the middle of the water, told to watch these things because they will be a sign, alongside major earthquakes in the Pacific and Chinese activity at the Panama Canal.
